text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is literally shaking with<n>excitement.
It's clear she can't wait<n>to show everyone how
much she's<n>improved.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She promises to exceed my<n>expectations for her on
the track, and<n>with those encouraging words, she
sets off for her big race.
